routing_warnings.description: The reported inability of the dashboards to clearly present debt performance concerns dashboard clarity rather than failure of the underlying financing and debt calculations.
The complaint concerns unclear presentation and inability to understand how figures were generated, rather than directly establishing incorrect calculations.
The reported failure primarily concerns model complexity, reviewability, and auditability.
The freelancer's claim that every number traces to a source on the Assumptions tab primarily implements assumption and source traceability.
The claim about clearly sourced assumptions supports traceability, while the other listed revisions belong to dashboard, financial-statement, and presentation Requirements.
The separate complaint that the dashboards do not clearly present decision metrics belongs to the Government Decision Dashboard Requirement.
The separate request for a clearer investment story belongs to the Government Investment Narrative Requirement.

The claim that figures trace to sources on the Assumptions tab primarily supports the Assumption and Source Traceability Requirement; restructuring into a simpler front page is only proposed, not claimed complete.
The complaint concerns the overall presentation and understandability of the model without specifically identifying the decision dashboard.
The request to simplify the model targets overall model structure rather than the dashboard's decision metrics.
The complaint that the delivered work is difficult to understand concerns overall model usability and does not specifically entail a dashboard failure.
The complaint that the presentation and generated numbers are difficult to understand primarily concerns model clarity and auditability rather than the investment narrative.
